description: This is a Dart source file defining the 'HomeController' class, which manages the state and data fetching logic for the Home section of a Flutter application. It handles loading home feed content, caching, refresh mechanisms, and continue watching features.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A controller class extending ChangeNotifier, managing state, data loading, and refresh logic for the Home view, including cache management and continue watching features.

methods.name: loadHomeFeed
methods.description: Fetches the home feed data, updates state accordingly, handles errors, and triggers continue watching load.

methods.name: loadContinueWatching
methods.description: Loads the user's recent watch history and details of items for the Continue Watching section.

methods.name: onPlaybackProgressPersisted
methods.description: Refreshes the continue watching list after playback progress has been saved.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of data based on cache updates, including the home feed and continue watching items.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up listeners and timers, and marks the controller as disposed.
